metadata.title: COBO L2 macOS Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: Operating system–specific System Security and Privacy Plan defining how Apple macOS endpoints implement the COBO L2 enhanced-assurance endpoint trust tier.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: An Apple macOS endpoint configured to meet enhanced COBO L2 requirements for sensitive data handling, elevated trust, and privileged institutional workflows.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: This macOS SSPP inherits all COBO L2 requirements and all underlying COBO L1 macOS requirements.

props.name: supported-versions
props.remarks: Only currently supported macOS versions approved for COBO L2 use are permitted.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: macOS endpoint is owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: macOS endpoint is centrally enrolled and governed using institutional MDM services.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: macOS endpoint identity must use Secure Enclave–backed private keys, PKI-issued device certificates, and support hardware-backed attestation.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: macOS cryptographic operations must rely on platform cryptographic services operating in FIPS 140-3–validated modes where applicable.

props.name: secure-boot-and-platform-integrity
props.remarks: Apple Secure Boot, sealed system volume, and platform integrity protections must be enabled and enforced.

props.name: system-integrity-protection
props.remarks: System Integrity Protection (SIP) must be enabled in its strictest supported configuration.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: macOS configuration applies CIS macOS Benchmark Level 2 (or institutionally approved equivalent enhanced baseline).

props.name: credential-and-secret-protection
props.remarks: Credentials and secrets must be protected using Secure Enclave–backed Keychain controls and restricted access policies.

props.name: malware-and-threat-protection
props.remarks: Apple XProtect, Gatekeeper, and institution-approved advanced endpoint threat protection tooling must be enabled.

props.name: posture-and-health-reporting
props.remarks: macOS endpoints continuously report posture and compliance signals with higher assurance guarantees than COBO L1.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: macOS COBO L2 endpoints may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1, 2, and 3.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Enhanced endpoint assurance does not confer automatic entitlement to any data classification.

props.name: privileged-workload-support
props.remarks: macOS COBO L2 endpoints may be used for privileged and administrative workflows where explicitly authorized.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: macOS COBO L2 endpoints are subject to heightened lifecycle governance, including stricter suspension, recovery, and audit requirements.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines how macOS implements COBO L2 enhanced endpoint trust using Apple hardware security features, strict configuration baselines, and centralized management.

control-implementation.remarks: macOS configuration profiles, MDM policies, CIS-aligned baselines, and endpoint protection tooling implement this SSPP and are maintained as controlled, versioned implementation artifacts.
